title: The computational complexity of Weisfeiler–Leman refinement

result.label: The computational complexity of Weisfeiler–Leman refinement
result.statement: Proves unconditional n^ (k) deterministic time lower bounds for joint and separate k -dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence, for sufficiently large fixed k in the specified sequential adjacency-matrix models. With dimension as input, joint equivalence is EXPTIME-complete even on subcubic graphs; deciding whether refinement identifies a graph is also EXPTIME-complete.
